title: Pure Generaider
summary: Generaider cards only, with generic Rank 9s, Links and staples. Every Generaider Boss is a Level 9 that you can only control one copy of, and each one tributes Generaider monsters on either turn for a big effect. Nidhogg negates a Special Summon, Harr negates an activation, Utgarda banishes a card, and Frodi destroys monsters. Loptr, Shadow of the Generaider Bosses tributes a Generaider to summon a different Level 9 Boss from the Deck. Generaider Boss Stage summons a Boss whenever the opponent adds a card from the Deck, then makes Tokens to tribute on their turn. Generaider Boss Quest searches two Generaider Spells/Traps. The 2023 cards lead. Vala, Seidhr of the Generaider Bosses summons itself by sending a Generaider card and brings another Generaider back. Laevatein, Generaider Boss of Shadows shrinks their monsters and turns into another Generaider Xyz.
